# Hollingsworth Logistics to add 150 jobs with Schertz expansion

Kelsey Brown

Mon, October 5, 2026 at 7:06 PM UTC

View larger image

A Michigan-based supply chain provider will consolidate its Schertz operations into a 340,090-square-foot facility at Park35. (Bibb T. Gault/Cavender & Hill Properties)

The city of Schertz is boosting its workforce through a long-term deal with a leading supply chain provider in the manufacturing and distribution industry.

Hollingsworth Logistics Group signed a seven-year lease to expand and consolidate its Schertz operations, which will retain the company's 224 employees and add another 150 to its payroll. The move is intended to help the Michigan-headquartered company scale its operations to meet the demand from its customers across the aerospace, automotive, government, industrial and retail sectors.

The expansion stems from an economic development performance agreement between the company and the Schertz Economic Development Corp. approved by the Schertz City Council.

#### New Kenosha hub significantly expands G10 Fulfillment’s Midwest warehouse capacity

 Posted in Kenosha County Economic Development 

A Delavan-based third-party logistics and fulfillment company has significantly expanded its Midwest warehouse capacity after moving into a new distribution facility in Kenosha.

G10 Fulfillment now occupies 315,000 square feet of a 600,000-square-foot building at 12345 38th St., just off Interstate 94. The move increases G10’s dock capacity to 65 doors from 30.

“The Midwest is probably the most important hub for us,” said co-founder and CEO Mark Becker, who was on hand Thursday for a ribbon-cutting at the facility. He pointed to the region’s freight infrastructure and its location along the trucking corridor between Chicago and Milwaukee.

Becker said the facility can handle nearly 7 acres of inventory under one roof. G10 shares the building with food manufacturer Eagle Foods.

G10 invested about $2 million in the Kenosha buildout, which Becker said covered racking, automation and staffing costs.

Maersk Invests $100 Million in Massachusetts Fulfillment Hub - Supply Chain 24/7

## The new 617,000-square-foot Maersk fulfillment center will open in late August and create about 1,000 jobs

 

Source: Courtesy of Maersk

Maersk is investing $100 million in a new fulfillment center in Hopedale, Massachusetts, creating about 1,000 jobs and expanding Northeast delivery capacity.

 By 24/7 Staff July 16, 2026 

Maersk will open a new 617,000-square-foot fulfillment center in Hopedale, Massachusetts, later this summer, investing $100 million in the project and creating approximately 1,000 jobs.

The facility will become part of Maersk's North American contract logistics network and will work with a major e-commerce customer. At full capacity, the site is expected to process up to 330,000 units a day while expanding the company's fulfillment and delivery network across the Northeast.

The Hopedale facility marks one of Maersk's larger recent investments in U.S. logistics infrastructure as retailers and brands continue placing inventory closer to customers to speed deliveries.

# Maersk Opening $100 Million Fulfillment Hub in Hopedale

Fri, July 17, 2026 by Tyler Lawton

HOPEDALE – Global shipping and logistics company A.P. Moller – Maersk is expanding into Hopedale with a new $100 million fulfillment center that is expected to bring approximately 1,000 jobs to the region.

The new 617,000-square-foot facility will support several of the company’s major e-commerce customers and will be capable of processing up to 330,000 units per day during peak demand.

Maersk says operations are expected to begin in late August, and hiring has already started for a variety of positions at the new facility.

Linden Logistics Center Welcomes New Tenant - BINJE | New Jersey Business News

# Everflow Supplies leases entire 332,635-SF facility at Linden Logistics Center

Brings park's existing buildings to 100% leased

 Linda Lindner

October 6, 2026

National specialty products distributor Everflow Supplies has signed a full-building lease for 332,635 square feet at 100 Linden Logistics Way, anchoring a major milestone for the 4.1-million-square-foot Linden Logistics Center in Linden.

With this transaction, developed by a partnership of Advance Realty Investors, Greek Real Estate Partners (GREP), and PGIM Real Estate, all seven of the industrial park’s existing buildings are now fully leased.

### Expanding operations and corporate headquarters

Everflow Supplies—a national provider of plumbing, HVAC, mechanical, fire protection, electrical, and industrial products backed by private equity firm Paceline Equity Partners—will use the new facility to consolidate operations, expand capacity, and establish its new corporate headquarters. The building will also support the integration of recent business acquisitions following expansion into Georgia and Southern California earlier in the year.

400,000 square foot site takes Arvato’s total Louisville footprint beyond four million square feet.

By DC Velocity Staff Oct 05, 2026

DC Velocity Staff See Full Bio 

The supply chain management and e-commerce third party logistics provider (3PL) Arvato has opened its seventh logistics facility in Louisville, Kentucky, saying the move further expands its presence in one of the United States’ most important logistics hubs.

The new, wholly-owned site adds approximately 400,000 square feet of capacity, taking Arvato’s total Louisville footprint beyond four million square feet. Expected to create approximately 150 new jobs, the facility further strengthens the company’s ability to support growing fulfillment and distribution requirements for clients across North America, Arvato said.
